commit.message:
feat(models): default z.ai GLM to glm-5.4 (#3644)

z.ai released GLM-5.4 on 2026-11-23 on its Coding Plan, the
/api/anthropic wire iterion reaches z.ai through. Every default that
names z.ai's GLM moves to it:

- secrets.ZAIDefaultModel ("glm-5.4") is the one Go source: detect's
  and the cloud catalogue's z.ai suggestion (the model a claw node with
  no model lands on when only z.ai is credentialed) read it.
- The catalogue's GLM rescue routes (review-pr reviewer_alternate,
  revi-converse converse_agent, gitops-warden classify) name glm-5.4;
  each manifest carries a patch bump. The Revi default-walk golden and
  map-bots follow.
- bots/catalog_zai_default_model_test.go holds every z.ai GLM route of
  the catalogue (node model, fallback, zai:<model> chain element) to
  ZAIDefaultModel, with a floor on how many routes it must see.
- `iterion models` lists anthropic/glm-5.4; the GLM window comment and
  the generation test pin 5.4 at 1M (models.dev:
  zai-coding-plan/glm-5.4, 1M ctx / 131072 out).
- Docs, the DSL quickref, sec-audit's chain example, the e2e narrowing
  fixture and the z.ai live probe move with it. Scaleway routes stay on
  glm-5.3: Scaleway does not serve 5.4 (no open weights yet).

glm-5.4 has no published price yet (models.dev lists it at 0 on the
coding plan only; OpenRouter does not serve it), so its tokens book as
unpriced spend: an advisory budget warning, never a refusal. The
known-zero extraction test seeds its price fixture from
ZAIDefaultModel instead of a literal 5.3.

Proof: ZAI_LIVE_PROBE=1 TestLiveZaiStream green on glm-5.4; a direct
/v1/messages call answers "model":"glm-5.4" (HTTP 200) while glm-9.9
is refused 400/1211, so z.ai does not alias an unknown id.
Mutated: gitops-warden's route back on 5.3, review-pr's route back on
5.3, the walk's fallback check removed (floor red), ZAIDefaultModel
back on 5.3 (detect_test red); each red on its own assertion, restored
byte-identical.

Refs #3631

Landed by admin bypass of the merge queue. revi/review and the
required set (test, race, vendor-check, mongo-conformance, golangci,
brand) were green on 8d81b90e. The queue ejected the PR twice, each
time on race-shard legs this diff does not reach:
internal/fswatch TestEveryRawWatcherAddGoesThroughFswatch (go list
-export killed at 600s), pkg/dsl/ir TestNodeChainCompilesLinearly
(11.3s against a 10s budget) and pkg/runview/runstream
TestFileSourceSettleWindowRechecksAResumedRun. The same legs were red
on main pushes in the same window, and the two latter tests are green
locally under -race (3/3, 10/10).
Integration train: origin/main 8f2068563 + 8d81b90e merged --no-ff
(ed4510ee7, clean): task -x fmt:check and task -x check exit 0;
go test -race green on pkg/backend/detect, pkg/backend/model,
pkg/modelcatalog, pkg/secrets, pkg/server/cloudpublisher,
internal/mdcode, cmd/iterion and the bots tests the diff changes (the
whole bots package under -race outruns go test's 600s default; CI
bounds it at 2400s and ran it green on the PR head). main did not move
between the train and this merge.

Gate-Bypass: merge queue ejected on race-shard flakes unrelated to the diff — #3644
